interface.name: aqua_text_field_manager_v1
interface.description: Optional geometry alongside text-input-v3. No text or secrets are exposed to other clients. Coordinates are surface-local logical units. State is applied on wl_surface.commit. Only one field object may exist per surface. Describe the focused field only, clearing the geometry on blur. Compositors must not infer field bounds from cursor rectangles.

entry.name: already_exists
entry.summary: surface already has a field object

interface.name: aqua_text_field_v1
interface.description: Rounded-rectangle bounds, not caret bounds. Radius is clamped to half the smaller dimension. Invalid geometry is discarded. This object never grants text-input access.
